'''Philip Bond''' is a British researcher recognized for leading an independent review on knowledge exchange in the mathematical sciences for UKRI – [[UK Research and Innovation]]. His 2018 report, 'The era of mathematics'<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ukri.org/publications/the-era-of-mathematics|title=The era of mathematics|last=Bond|first=Philip|year= 2018|website=UKRI.org|publisher=UKRI |access-date=2026-02-02}}</ref>
highlights the critical, increasing role of mathematical modelling and data analysis across various UK industrial sectors and led to the founding of a new [[national academy]] for [[Academy for the Mathematical Sciences|mathematical sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gov.uk/government/calls-for-evidence/national-academy-for-the-mathematical-sciences-proposed-focus-and-objectives/outcome/national-academy-for-mathematical-sciences-government-response|title=National Academy for mathematical sciences: government response|publisher=gov.uk|year=2024}}</ref>

Bond is a professor of creativity and innovation at the [[University of Manchester]], a visiting professor in the Departments of Engineering Mathematics and Computer Science at the University of Bristol, and a visiting fellow in the Oxford Industrial and Applied Mathematics Centre.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://royalsociety.org/people/philip-bond-13042|title=Philip Bond FRS|year=2008|website=royalsociety.org|publisher=The Royal Society|access-date=2026-02-02}}</ref>

In 2020, Bond was elected a fellow of the [[Royal Academy of Engineering]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://raeng.org.uk/news/academy-welcomes-53-leading-uk-and-international-engineers-as-new-fellows|title=Academy welcomes 53 leading UK and international engineers as new Fellows|year=2020|publisher=[[Royal Academy of Engineering]]}}</ref> In 2012 he led a UK government foresight report on financial trading<ref>{{cite web|title=The future of computer trading in financial markets|url=https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/future-of-computer-trading-in-financial-markets-an-international-perspective|year=2012|publisher=gov.uk}}</ref> and in 2014 Bond was appointed to the UK [[Council for Science and Technology]] which advises the prime minister.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gov.uk/government/news/prime-minister-appoints-new-members-of-the-council-for-science-and-technology|title=Prime Minister appoints new members of the Council for Science and Technology|publisher=Gov.uk|year=2014}}</ref>
